what: Split the steward's base-check request into two jobs (20261018-073507-j8rs, 20261018-073510-m3yh) after its planned job 20261018-070117-qmxv timed out: the plan touched 10 files in 4 crates and the critic accepted it with only minor findings.
why: Athena's critic does not hold plans to a size bound, so an oversized plan went to the producer and ran out of time; until the critic sizes plans, the operator splits.
